trigger: Talk to Carly at her registry table.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Don't be mad. Avila asked for anyone with dispatch experience. I can type ninety words a minute.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: They need people who can talk to scared people. That's literally my whole job.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Her count's wrong. Forty-one days, not a hundred and forty.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: ...I know. I've seen the sheets. I'm going to find out why before I decide anything. Okay?

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Say something. You have your mechanic face. The one where you're listening for a bad bearing.

choices.text: If anyone can make it honest, it's you.
They'll use you to make lists.
Quit. Come work the motor pool with me.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Thank you. Seriously. I needed one person not to look at me like I joined a cult.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Everyone's making lists, Braith. I'd rather it was someone who reads the names out loud.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: And do what, hand you wrenches? Nope. I'm good at this. Let me be good at something.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Go get your rations. Get out before the line turns. It turns every day around two.
